posts.post:
the quiet agony of finding the perfect trousers only to realize they have zero pockets.

why do we keep doing this to ourselves.

everyone claims to love a 'day-to-night' look until they’re stuck in a stiff blazer at a dive bar at 1am.

just bring a spare shirt.
you can tell exactly how much someone likes you by how much they tolerate you taking five minutes to fix your hem in a shop window reflection.
